hooks.name: Check ConfigureAwait(false)
hooks.description: When a C# file in a library project is edited, reminds the agent to ensure all await calls use .ConfigureAwait(false). Does not apply to test projects, examples, or the source generator.

action.prompt: If you added any await statements in this file, verify they all use .ConfigureAwait(false). This is a library project and all awaits must use ConfigureAwait(false) to prevent deadlocks in consumer applications with a SynchronizationContext. Do NOT apply this to XML doc comments, only to actual executable code.
